Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dilutionrisk 0.1.0 (Development)

Major Changes

New Features

Homogeneous Batch Models
  • Added prob_detection_homogeneous() - Calculate probability of detection for homogeneous batches
  • Added prob_detection_homogeneous_multiple() - Calculate PD for multiple dilution schemes
  • Added prob_acceptance_homogeneous() - Calculate probability of acceptance for sampling plans
  • Added prob_acceptance_homogeneous_multiple() - Calculate PA for multiple dilution schemes
  • Added cv_homogeneous() - Estimate coefficient of variation for homogeneous batches
  • Added cv_homogeneous_multiple() - Estimate CV for multiple dilution schemes
  • Added cv_curves_homogeneous() - Generate CV curves for homogeneous batches
  • Added OC_curves_homogeneous() - Generate operating characteristic curves
  • Added pd_curves_homogeneous() - Generate probability of detection curves
  • Added true_concentration_homogeneous() - Estimate true concentration
  • Added true_concentration_homogeneous_multiple() - Estimate concentration for multiple schemes
  • Added true_concentration_curves_homogeneous() - Generate concentration curves
Heterogeneous Batch Models
  • Added prob_detection_heterogeneous() - Calculate probability of detection for heterogeneous batches
  • Added prob_detection_heterogeneous_multiple() - Calculate PD for multiple dilution schemes
  • Added prob_acceptance_heterogeneous() - Calculate probability of acceptance for sampling plans
  • Added prob_acceptance_heterogeneous_multiple() - Calculate PA for multiple dilution schemes
  • Added cv_heterogeneous() - Estimate coefficient of variation for heterogeneous batches
  • Added cv_heterogeneous_multiple() - Estimate CV for multiple dilution schemes
  • Added cv_curves_heterogeneous() - Generate CV curves for heterogeneous batches
  • Added OC_curves_heterogeneous() - Generate operating characteristic curves
  • Added pd_curves_heterogeneous() - Generate probability of detection curves
  • Added true_concentration_heterogeneous() - Estimate true concentration
  • Added true_concentration_heterogeneous_multiple() - Estimate concentration for multiple schemes
  • Added true_concentration_curves_heterogeneous() - Generate concentration curves
Distribution Functions
  • Added rtrunpoilog() - Generate random numbers from truncated Poisson-lognormal distribution
Validation Functions
  • Added pd_validation_homogeneous() - Validate homogeneous model with simulations
  • Added pd_validation_heterogeneous() - Validate heterogeneous model with simulations

Performance Improvements

  • Implemented C++ code using Rcpp for efficient random number generation
  • Optimized probability calculations using log-sum-exp for numerical stability
  • Added progress bars for long simulations
  • Improved vectorization for multiple dilution scheme calculations

Documentation

  • Added comprehensive package documentation
  • Added vignettes:
    • Introduction to dilutionrisk
    • Homogeneous Batch Models
    • Heterogeneous Batch Models
    • Validation and Simulation
    • Case Studies
  • Created pkgdown website for online documentation
  • Added PDF manual
  • Added README with examples and installation instructions

Testing

  • Added unit tests using testthat
  • Added test coverage tracking with covr
  • Added continuous integration with GitHub Actions
  • Added CI/CD workflows:
    • R-CMD-check
    • Test coverage
    • pkgdown build and deploy

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed numerical stability issues in probability calculations
  • Fixed edge cases when USL * f * u < 1
  • Fixed input validation for all functions
  • Fixed memory issues in large simulations

Deprecated Functions

  • None (initial release)

Breaking Changes

  • None (initial release)

dilutionrisk 0.0.1 (Pre-release)

Initial Development

Features

  • Basic probability of detection calculations
  • Basic probability of acceptance calculations
  • Simulation-based validation
  • Truncated Poisson-lognormal distribution

Known Issues

  • Numerical stability issues in extreme cases
  • No formal testing framework
  • Limited documentation
  • No vignettes

How to Contribute

We welcome contributions to dilutionrisk! Please see our contributing guidelines.

Reporting Issues

If you find a bug or have a feature request, please open an issue on GitHub: https://github.com/Mayooran1987/dilutionrisk/issues

Submitting Changes

  1. Fork the repository
  2. Create a new branch for your changes
  3. Make your changes
  4. Submit a pull request
